verdict.rationale: Poke is a messaging-based AI assistant, so real-time voice conversation is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows text messaging on Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp and RCS. The one phone-call mention refers to real people carrying out tasks on the user's behalf, not a live voice conversation with the assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
